'''Loredana Angela Mihai''' [[Institute of Mathematics and its Applications|FIMA]] [[Learned Society of Wales|FLSW]] is a British [[Applied mathematics|applied mathematician]] and [[numerical analysis|numerical analyst]]. Originally from [[Romania]], she is Professor of Applied Mathematics  at [[Cardiff University]]<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Professor Angela Mihai - People |url=https://profiles.cardiff.ac.uk/staff/mihaila |access-date=2025-06-22 |website=Cardiff University |language=en}}</ref>  where her interdisciplinary work bridges [[mathematics]] with [[materials science]] and [[biomechanics]].

She contributed research on soft, smart, and biological materials through pioneering approaches like [[stochastic]] [[model]]ling of [[Elasticity (physics)|elasticity]]<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Mihai |first=L. Angela |date=2022 |title=Stochastic Elasticity |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-031-06692-4 |journal=Interdisciplinary Applied Mathematics |volume=55 |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-031-06692-4 |isbn=978-3-031-06691-7 |issn=0939-6047|url-access=subscription }}</ref> that bring mathematical rigour to real-world materials with complex behaviours.

==Education and career==
Mihai earned her PhD in numerical analysis at [[Durham University]] in 2005.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Loredana Mihai - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=164199 |access-date=2025-06-22 |website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref> After postdoctoral research at the [[University of Strathclyde]], [[University of Cambridge]], and [[University of Oxford]], she joined the Cardiff University academic staff as a lecturer in 2011.<ref name=":0" />

==Leadership and service==
From 2023 to 2025, she served as Vice President of the United Kingdom and Republic of Ireland Section of the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dr Angela Mihai elected Vice President of SIAM-UKIE |url=https://www.cardiff.ac.uk/news/view/2721712-director-of-research-dr-angela-mihai-elected-vice-president-of-siam-ukie |access-date=2025-06-22 |website=Cardiff University |language=en}}</ref>

== Recognition ==
Mihai is a Fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematics and its Applications]] and a Fellow of the [[Learned Society of Wales]].<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Wales |first1=The Learned Society of |last2=Boyle |first2=Joe |date=2025-04-29 |title=Welcome to our new Fellows 2025: solving the challenges we face |url=https://www.learnedsociety.wales/welcome-to-our-new-fellows-2025-solving-the-challenges-we-face/ |access-date=2025-06-22 |website=The Learned Society of Wales |language=en-US}}</ref>
